evidence.title: RECIPE CARD - AF-12 anti-rust alkyd enamel
evidence.claim: Earliest archived recipe revision containing the step is dated 1996-01-22.
evidence.quote: 8. Rest batch 12 h in holding tank before QC sample.

evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-1996-003
evidence.claim: In 1996, the 12-hour rest was introduced to detect livering caused by alkaline chromate pigment before filling, as per DR-1995-031.
evidence.quote: detect livering caused by alkaline chromate pigment before the batch is filled

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-1995-031
evidence.claim: In 1995, AF-12 enamel batches suffered from livering (rubbery gel) after 4-6 weeks of storage, which was not detectable at the time of filling.
evidence.quote: tins opened after 4 to 6 weeks of storage show the enamel thickened into a rubbery gel ("livering")

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-1995-031
evidence.claim: The 1995 livering was suspected to be caused by a reaction between the alkyd acid groups and basic lead chromate from Cromopigmenti Lazzeretti.
evidence.quote: Suspected cause: reaction between the acid groups of the alkyd and the basic lead chromate pigment

evidence.title: Minutes - production meeting, 13 May 2008
evidence.claim: As of 2008, no livering cases had been reported since 1996, but the 12-hour rest was maintained due to low priority for review.
evidence.quote: Marchisio: no livering case since 1996. Decision: keep for now, review later (low priority).

evidence.title: Compliance memo CM-2006-004: phase-out of lead chromate pigments
evidence.claim: In 2006, basic lead chromate CL-77 in AF-12 was scheduled for replacement by zinc phosphate ZP-40 by December 31, 2006.
evidence.quote: basic lead chromate CL-77 will be replaced by zinc phosphate ZP-40

evidence.title: Compliance memo CM-2006-004: phase-out of lead chromate pigments
evidence.claim: In 2006, basic lead chromate CL-77 in AF-12 was replaced by zinc phosphate ZP-40 from Fosfazinco Nord by the end of the year.
evidence.quote: basic lead chromate CL-77 will be replaced by zinc phosphate ZP-40 from Fosfazinco Nord

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2007-002 - Fosfazinco Nord S.p.A., ZP-40
evidence.claim: In 2007, trial batches of AF-12 using ZP-40 showed no livering after 12 weeks of accelerated storage stability tests.
evidence.quote: Trial batches AF-12 with ZP-40 (T1-T3): storage stability 12 weeks at 40 °C - no livering

verdict.instruction: Transfer to holding tank and rest the batch 12 h before QC sampling.
verdict.reason: The step was introduced to detect livering caused by basic lead chromate pigment (E3, E4, E5). This pigment was replaced by zinc phosphate ZP-40 by the end of 2006 (E7, E8), and subsequent stability tests confirmed that ZP-40 does not cause livering (E9).

chain.claim: The 12-hour rest was introduced to detect livering caused by alkaline chromate pigment

dependencies.name: use of basic lead chromate pigment
dependencies.note: Replaced by zinc phosphate ZP-40 by end of 2006

counter_evidence.resolution: Maintained only due to low priority for review, not because the hazard persisted
